en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a modernist exhibition complex with flat‑roofed pavilions, flagpoles flying various national flags, manicured gardens and walkways in the foreground, and statues on plinths in front of a glass‑fronted hall. A tall tower with signage stands in the background. Printed captions in Greek and English along the bottom identify the scene as the International Fair of Salonica.
